title: pilosella hispidissima
intro: Pilosella hispidissima, commonly known as Saw Wort, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pilosella hispidissima include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
